review.decision: reject current composition; preserve evidence, keep generic default, request new Checkpoint 1 correction authorization

findings.defect: Foreground blocks the view and suppresses the matte
findings.evidence: Hero image is dominated by large leaf sprays and shrub stems; valley/sky occupy small fragmented openings rather than the broad middle/background of the concept.
findings.cause: Confirmed geometric canopy/understory projection overlaps the reference viewing corridor; hypothesis: near crown reach and shrub size/density were calibrated in world units without adequate projected occupancy constraints.
findings.action: Recompose the existing roles to a tested camera envelope; make the principal oak largely lateral/overhead; reserve the central valley sightline before dressing.

findings.defect: Inadequate shrub/crown representation and flat wood
findings.evidence: Large angular leaves and exposed crisscross stems read as an intrusive thicket. Foreground trunk is smooth and sparsely articulated; the concept has fine sclerophyll foliage grouped into connected masses and textured bark.
findings.cause: Confirmed reused low branchlet geometry was enlarged beyond its useful leaf scale; shared oak sprays are approximate and oversized at the chosen camera distance. Bark representation remains baseline.
findings.action: Reject this scaled branchlet construction for Mediterranean shrub masses; use branch-supported compact small-leaf clusters with mass-scale shading and distinct near/far simplification. Do not add density to this version.

findings.defect: Soil/terrain composition and background integration remain weak
findings.evidence: Hero soil is a flat-colored ribbon and rocks are largely hidden. Inspection reveals straight soil extrapolation outside the source frustum and broad undetailed terrain; generated matte cannot establish depth through current occluders.
findings.cause: Confirmed simple fallback route extends beyond the projected reference, and available near/mid geometry lacks the reference silhouette hierarchy. Texture matching intentionally deferred, but cannot conceal composition failure.
findings.action: Replace straight extrapolation with a bounded terrain-correlated route; inspect the principal rock/shoulder silhouettes without understory; only then evaluate matte horizon overlap.
